summary: ptracemusl's delayed and delayed-poll rows on i686, each booted alone, on a kernel built from a private copy with the debug-entry fixture of tests/proofs/ptrace_fixture.py, with faults in the forced delivery of a deferred hit, in signal_pending's view of it, and in the fixture itself; x86-64 adds the entry row and faults in its debug interrupt stack and GS

argv: exec sh tests/proofs/ptrace.sh rows ${WORK} delayed delayed-poll
